summary: Phase 8 seller polish (uploads + partial PATCH + low-stock) verified end-to-end. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_phase8_uploads_and_partial.py — 13/13 PASS in 4.3s. Covers (a) POST /api/uploads/image: unauth->401, text/plain->400, empty->400, >8MB->400, valid 70-byte PNG->200 returns {url:'/api/uploads/terramart/uploads/<uid>/<uuid>.png', path, size:70}; then public GET (no auth) returns the same bytes with image/* content-type. (b) PATCH /api/seller/products/{id} partial payloads: {price:299} only updates price (title/category/images/stock unchanged, seller_verified stays true), {stock:12} only updates stock, {images:[]}->400, {category:'moon-rocks'}->400, seller2 patching seller1 product->404. (c) GET /api/seller/products decorates low_stock:true when stock<5 (patched to 2 -> low_stock=true), false when patched to 20. (d) Deny paths: /api/seller/products returns 403 for buyer and admin tokens. Frontend (Playwright, seller1 login on https://buildmat-bazaar.preview.emergentagent.com/seller/login): opened Add Product modal, upload-dropzone + upload-file-input present, set_input_files with /tmp/tiny.png (70-byte PNG) -> image-preview-0 rendered from real uploaded /api/uploads/... URL (buyer-side ProductCard uses same resolveImg). Filled title/category=tiles/price=499/stock=3, saved -> new row rendered with low-stock-badge-{id} and ochre row bg. Inline edit: clicked price-cell-{id} -> inline-price-{id} appeared with current value, changed to 799, inline-save -> toast 'Updated' + cell shows ₹799 without opening modal. Clicked stock-cell-{id}, changed to 20, saved -> low-stock badge disappeared. Cancel test: opened inline price, typed 9999, inline-cancel -> reverts to ₹799 (not persisted). Cleanup via DELETE /api/seller/products/{id} = 200. resolveImg() correctly prefixes REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to /api/uploads/... URLs in both ProductCard.jsx and SellerDashboardPage.jsx.

minor.issue: Ownership is not enforced on GET /api/uploads/{path}. Any authenticated OR anonymous user who guesses the path can fetch the file. This is intentional per spec (buyer-side render needs public GET), but there is also no path-traversal guard on the {path:path} param — the storage backend probably rejects it, but a small allow-list regex (^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-/.]+\.(png|jpg|jpeg|webp|gif)$) would be safer.

Buyers (role=buyer) can also upload images because the endpoint only depends on get_current_user, not require_seller. Storage cost / abuse risk. Consider Depends(require_seller) unless buyer avatars/reviews will use it later.
SellerProductPatch uses exclude_none, so a client that legitimately wants to clear an optional field like description/material cannot set it to empty via null. Minor UX limitation.

issues: React dev-only hydration warning in console: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' — coming from x-source-var instrumentation wrapping <option> children in <span> inside the orders-status <select data-testid=dash-status-{short_id}>. Not caused by Phase 8 code; not visible to users; ignore or strip the instrumentation for <option> children.

action_items: (Optional) Restrict POST /api/uploads/image to sellers (Depends(require_seller)) to prevent buyer abuse.
(Optional) Add a path/extension allow-list regex on GET /api/uploads/{path} for defence-in-depth.
(Optional) Consider allowing empty-string clears for description/material in SellerProductPatch (drop exclude_none for those fields).
critical_code_review_comments: put_object/get_object retry on 404 by re-init'ing the storage key is smart, but the retry does not re-read the response body — if the retried call also 404s the client will see the ~raw HTTPError from requests, not a clean 502/503. Wrap the retry in try/except.
server.py is now ~1580 lines with a fresh uploads module bolted on — splitting into routers (uploads.py, seller.py, admin.py) is overdue.
db.files has no index on storage_path — GET /api/uploads/{path} does a collection scan on every image load. Add a unique index on storage_path at startup.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of targeted flows (upload UI, low-stock, inline price/stock, cancel)
